name: Inteleon

shiny_prompt: Use case identity-preserve. Recolour all32 sprites of the existing transparent8column4row game atlas image1 to the EXACT native SHINY palette of image2. review.scope: Independent visual review, normal and shiny separately; exact PNG hashes checked
